About Talk To Figma Plugin

This plugin allows Cursor AI to communicate with Figma, enabling AI-assisted design operations. Github

Version: 1.1.0

How to Use

  1. Trong BA Studio → Prototype, bấm Start socket và chờ READY
  2. Connect to the server using the port number (default: 3055)
  3. Copy Channel ID vào BA Studio sau khi plugin kết nối

BA Studio asset extension. Connects only to your local relay. No analytics.
